reason: Every one of my 5-15 clients a year came from someone else's recommendation, and I have never seen a farmer or an SME owner in Bihor pick a grant writer off Google. Four thousand euro in the first year is close to a tenth of my firm's revenue, spent on fixing a problem I don't have.
objection: I am signing a 12-month subscription with a database developer who does this 10-12 hours a week on the side. When he has a deadline at his real job, or gets a better one, who keeps my document-upload link and my calendar automation alive? A broken intake form is worse than no form.
would_change_my_mind: Two consultants I actually know, in my field, telling me over coffee that the document-chasing automation alone saved them real hours during a call deadline, and a written answer to what happens to my site and automations if he stops.
